description: This source file implements functions and hooks for tensor sharding, parameter sharding, and module sharding within the PyTorch distributed _shard API. It manages tensor sharding based on sharding specifications, tracks process groups, and enables sharding of modules and their outputs according to sharding plans, primarily for distributed training scenarios.

methods.name: ShardedTensor _shard_tensor( tensor: torch.Tensor, sharding_spec: ShardingSpec, src_rank=0, process_group=None )
methods.description: Shards a tensor according to a provided sharding specification, ensuring data consistency and coordination across process groups.

methods.name: shard_parameter( module: torch.nn.Module, param_name: str, sharding_spec: ShardingSpec, src_rank=0, process_group=None, )
methods.description: Replaces a module's parameter with a shard according to the sharding specification.

methods.name: load_with_process_group(process_group)
methods.description: Context manager to set a specific process group during loading operations involving sharded tensors.

methods.name: _get_current_process_group()
methods.description: Retrieves the current process group, defaulting to the global default if not explicitly set.

methods.name: torch.nn.Module _reshard_output( module: torch.nn.Module, resharding_spec: ShardingSpec )
methods.description: Hooks a module to reshard its output tensor according to a specified sharding pattern.

methods.name: torch.nn.Module _collect_local_shard(module: torch.nn.Module)
methods.description: Hooks a module to collect and return its local shard, possibly squeezing singleton dimensions for ChunkShardingSpec.

methods.name: shard_module(module: nn.Module, plan: ShardingPlan, src_rank=0, process_group=None)
methods.description: Distributes and shards a module's parameters and output according to a provided sharding plan, supporting complex sharding strategies.
